doc: FBL 0.11, section 4.9 (The tree, comments), FR-001 and FR-004: every comment form the DSL takes, owned as the rules say. 'model { // trailing a brace is legal' is the model entry's trailing comment, not its first child's; the hash and line comments directly above 'u = person' are u's leading comments; '/* block comment between elements */' starts its line, so it leads s. Removing u takes its leading comments with its line span and, by cascade, the relationship that names it, and leaves the block comment with s. The input is etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/c4/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.C4.Tests/Fixtures/comments-everywhere.dsl at ad1a4680a, byte for byte.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
A set replaces the value's bytes only.
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
Removing u removes its line span, with the comments directly above it, and the relationship that names it (cascade); the block comment below u leads s and stays.
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
